purpose: Resolve unreliable semantic audio findings from the first autopsy and assess two already-existing clean music alternatives before scoring Grifon audio against the reference.

inputs.role: Native reference AAC stream; private inspection only
Existing registered clean Mixkit music; no old mixed master
Existing registered clean Mixkit music; no automatic reuse decision

analyzer.canonicalPromptToolProviderOrSkillChange: None. Proposed exact new prompt and bounded task-local adapter only, applied after approval.

budget.preflight: Verify exact three input hashes/durations and prompt/spec hashes; upload only named sources; count exact request tokens before generation; abort on count>12000 or uncertain cap/auth. Persist one attempt before generation. No alternate model/provider, additional analysis or retry.

pass: Returned JSON follows the exact prompt structure and preserves uncertainty.
All named-file times use numeric decimal seconds and lie within measured durations; no perfect sync/frame precision claim.
Reported input modality includes AUDIO; native reference track was supplied intact.
Sound/BPM hypotheses are cross-checked against existing free onset/silence measurements and independent review before use.
Token usage/cost receipt confirms one attempt and additional estimated cost<=0.10.
fail: Missing audio modality, implausible timing, unsupported sound identities, forced candidate choice, changed input or cap uncertainty; stop without retry.
rights: Private analysis only. Do not redistribute/sample reference audio or raw stock sources in the delivered player. No newly generated music/SFX or commercial-clearance assertion.
approval: No second paid analysis is authorized until Neil approves this exact changed-input/prompt spec.
